architecture.mechanism: Active control device for noise reduction of auxiliary assemblies
architecture.intervention: Install an active vibration and noise control device on the front wheel bearing and drivetrain assembly that monitors rotational speed and applies counter-phase actuation to cancel load-dependent vibration and humming between 25 and 75 mph.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of steering vibration and low humming sound under load, restoring smooth quiet operation across the 25 to 75 mph speed range.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the vehicle under load from 25 to 75 mph with the control device disabled versus enabled; if vibration amplitude and acoustic humming levels measured at the steering column do not decrease by a statistically significant margin when enabled, the intervention fails.
